name: Lanxi

routes.outcome: Official Jinhua open-data catalog page loaded and names Lanxi Natural Resources and Planning Bureau as the data provider. The listed dataset is an active-disclosure directory, not parcel geometry or a cadastral query service.
Official Lanxi Natural Resources and Planning Bureau planning notice loaded. It is a local custodian page, but it exposes no parcel API or downloadable safe parcel geometry.
Official Zhejiang government map viewer loaded. The viewer is a general public map service; no Lanxi parcel layer was visible in the page.
Current viewer JavaScript configuration inspected. It loads generic map modules and does not identify a Lanxi cadastral parcel service.
Current configuration inspected. It exposes public Zhejiang basemap, geocoding, WMS/WMTS and generic catalog routes; no anonymous Lanxi parcel vector endpoint or parcel schema was identified.
The requested current viewer path did not expose a parcel-specific response or stable native parcel identity. No login, credential, CAPTCHA, or certificate bypass was attempted.

Not used for parcel qualification: this is a generic tiled basemap route discovered in the viewer configuration, not a parcel query, and no parcel identity or geometry response was requested or retained.

schemaAndCrs.geometryCrs: No parcel geometry response obtained; CRS and coordinate order remain unverified for a Lanxi parcel source.

localCustodianAssessment: Lanxi Natural Resources and Planning Bureau is evidenced as the local data provider/custodian in the official Jinhua catalog and official Lanxi government pages. Jinhua and Zhejiang public map/catalog services are higher-level or general services; they were not treated as evidence of a Lanxi cadastral parcel layer.

qualification.reason: No anonymous parcel geometry or city-bounded public vector response was verified; a serial reviewer would need to independently qualify a real source before runtime consideration.

uncertainty: Local custody and a general official map/catalog route are evidenced, but anonymous parcel-service reachability, parcel schema/CRS, coverage, update cadence, licensing, and runtime behavior remain unverified. The absence of a public vector endpoint is an access/discovery limitation, not evidence of citywide cadastral absence.
